scope: Atomic editorial ChefFlow requirements anchored to specific vendor statements. Acceptance criteria are our proposed bar, not claims about a competitor.

benchmarks.title: Describe a dinner without creating an account

competitorClaims.statement: Customers provide date, party size and preferences.

acceptance: A guest can draft a request on a phone without an account or password wall.
Validate date, location, party size and dietary notes; show a real saved/submitted result and recoverable errors.
Any later identity step preserves the request and explains its purpose.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Compare chef proposals

competitorClaims.statement: Customers receive chef proposals.

acceptance: Compare actual offers for one request, with per-person and total price, currency, fees and inclusions.
Never fabricate availability or proposals; distinguish no offers, loading and request failure.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Discuss and customize a menu

competitorClaims.statement: Customers message chefs and customize menus.

acceptance: Host and chef messages refer to the same proposal and menu revision.
A dietary change remains visible through acceptance; the wrong participant cannot read the conversation.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Book with an explicit confirmed state

competitorClaims.statement: Customers book after discussing their proposals.

acceptance: Confirm the exact chef, date, agreed menu, amount and cancellation terms before submission.
Use idempotency for repeated taps and show confirmation only after the authoritative booking/payment result.
Failed or incomplete payments never appear as confirmed bookings.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Carry a booked dinner into service preparation

competitorClaims.statement: The booked service includes groceries, service and cleanup.

acceptance: One accepted booking feeds the event, dietary requirements, menu, shopping and prep without retyping.
Changes to the agreed menu are tracked, not silently substituted.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Keep a personal recipe collection

competitorClaims.statement: Users save recipes in a personal collection.

acceptance: Create, find, edit and reopen a private recipe after refresh.
Distinguish personal copies from credited public originals; do not silently publish private chef recipes.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Import a recipe from a permitted web source

competitorClaims.statement: The built-in browser imports web recipes.

acceptance: Import authorized structured recipe data with title, ingredients, instructions and original-source attribution.
Preview and correct parsing before save; duplicates, unsupported pages and failures have explicit outcomes.
Respect access restrictions and content rights; never bypass a paywall or treat a failed parse as success.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Scale ingredient quantities without changing instructions

competitorClaims.statement: Ingredient quantities can be scaled.

acceptance: Changing servings scales numeric amounts deterministically, preserving source servings and mixed fractions.
Non-numeric amounts and cooking times are not blindly multiplied; rounding is visible.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Convert compatible recipe measurements

competitorClaims.statement: The app converts ingredient units.

acceptance: Convert compatible mass and volume units with reversible rounding.
Never convert mass to volume without an explicit ingredient-specific density; unknown conversion is shown.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Build a grocery list from selected recipes

competitorClaims.statement: Recipe ingredients can be added to grocery lists.

acceptance: Selected recipes and servings produce a persisted shopping list with provenance to each recipe.
Manual edits survive recomputation; missing amounts are flagged rather than invented.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Combine equivalent grocery ingredients

competitorClaims.statement: Grocery quantities are automatically combined.

acceptance: Combine the same ingredient in compatible units while retaining all recipe contributions.
Keep incompatible units, dietary variants and materially different preparations separate.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Group a shopping list by aisle

competitorClaims.statement: Grocery items can be sorted by aisle.

acceptance: Group items into editable store categories with an uncategorized fallback.
Checking an item updates the saved list and is reversible on a phone.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Share a live household shopping list

competitorClaims.statement: Shared list changes appear for other participants.

acceptance: Two authorized household members see edits without overwriting each other.
Test simultaneous edits, reconnect, revoked access and read-only participants; exclude unrelated tenants.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Plan meals across a week

competitorClaims.statement: The planner supports arranging meals for the week.

acceptance: Place recipes into dated meals with servings; support moving, replacing and removing entries.
Mobile and keyboard interaction work without mandatory drag-and-drop.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Turn the meal plan into one shopping list

competitorClaims.statement: Recipes and meal plans become grocery lists.

acceptance: Generate one list for the selected date range, with per-meal provenance and servings.
Change a planned meal without duplicating items or erasing manual shopping entries.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Reuse a saved meal template

competitorClaims.statement: Reusable menus support meal planning.

acceptance: Copy a saved meal template into a new date range without mutating the original.
Shopping reflects the newly selected servings and excludes removed meals.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Follow a recipe step by step

competitorClaims.statement: Ingredients and current cooking steps can be marked.

acceptance: Track completed ingredients and the active instruction without altering the source recipe.
Persist progress across accidental navigation; expose accessible controls at phone width.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Start timers from recipe instructions

competitorClaims.statement: Cooking timers are detected from recipe directions.

acceptance: Recognize explicit durations and ask before creating an ambiguous timer.
Multiple named timers remain accurate after backgrounding; notification permission failure is explained.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Keep multiple dishes active while cooking

competitorClaims.statement: Multiple active recipes can be pinned.

acceptance: Switch between dishes without losing servings, step progress or timer ownership.
Unpinning one dish does not clear another dish.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Reopen recipes and plans on another device

competitorClaims.statement: Cloud synchronization connects devices.

acceptance: Reopen the same authorized saved collection on phone and desktop.
Make synchronization errors and conflicts visible without overwriting newer work.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Share food knowledge by explicit choice

competitorClaims.statement: Communities support food and recipe sharing.

acceptance: Share only specifically selected content, preserving attribution and permission.
Unsharing removes public access while retaining the owner copy; default is private.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Show nutrition with provenance and uncertainty

competitorClaims.statement: Recipes show nutritional information.

acceptance: Display source, serving size and completeness alongside nutrient values.
Unknown values stay unknown, not zero; estimates are not medical advice or an allergen guarantee.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Hand a reviewed ingredient basket to a retailer

competitorClaims.statement: Shoppable ingredients lead to Walmart checkout.

acceptance: Let the user review quantities, substitutions and retailer before an authorized handoff.
Show that checkout occurs externally; do not claim a purchase until the retailer confirms it.
Missing products and stale prices remain explicit; never purchase automatically.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Provide structured guided cooking

competitorClaims.statement: Recipes include step-by-step cooking guidance.

acceptance: Preserve ordered instructions, ingredient references and credited media.
The complete core recipe remains usable when media fails to load.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Suggest a weekly plan under explicit constraints

competitorClaims.statement: The service describes personalized weekly meal plans.

acceptance: Build a reviewable plan from permitted recipes using budget, time and stated preferences.
Hard dietary restrictions outrank preference ranking; explain incomplete ingredient/allergen information.
A suggestion is a draft, never an automatically committed plan.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Maintain versioned culinary knowledge

competitorClaims.statement: Recipes are searchable and versioned.

acceptance: Keep recipe versions with author, change time and reproducible ingredients and instructions.
Events retain their selected version unless an authorized update is explicitly accepted.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Cost edible yield and sub-recipes

competitorClaims.statement: Yield, conversion and scaling inform recipe costs.

acceptance: Calculate purchase-to-edible yield, nested recipe costs and portions deterministically.
Detect cycles, incompatible units and missing prices; show incomplete totals instead of a false exact margin.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Propagate ingredient price updates into costs

competitorClaims.statement: Invoice-fed ingredient costs update recipes.

acceptance: A reviewed supplier price update recalculates affected recipe cost with source and effective date.
Historical booked-event pricing is not silently rewritten by a current price change.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Compare menu-item contribution margins

competitorClaims.statement: Menu engineering uses costs and profitability.

acceptance: Show cost, selling price and contribution by item with consistent units and declared exclusions.
Do not rank an item with missing cost data as highly profitable.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Carry ingredient allergen information into service

competitorClaims.statement: Recipes support allergen tags.

acceptance: Propagate reviewed ingredient allergen data through nested recipes and menu revisions.
Flag unknown ingredients and cross-contact considerations; absence of a tag never means safe.
benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

benchmarks.title: Train staff using the selected recipe version

benchmarks.rationale: Remove a repeated food-related handoff while preserving authorization, source provenance and truthful failure states.

acceptance: Import an owned document into a draft with the original retained privately.
